text:
Sometimes, made of nothing,

an effluvium rises from the ground.

Suddenly, quietly,

the cedar sighs with aroma.


Since we are the thin

dissolution of a secret,

as soon as the soul yields a little

the fountain of a dream overflows.


Miserable thing, vague

reason, when, in the silence,

a kind of sun-glare

descends upon me from your memory!

translation.title: Barely
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the delicate movement from scent and secrecy to remembered light.
